notes.title: Posthaste Emporium 2.0
notes.content:
Greetings,
Today marks the highly anticipated 2.0 update for Posthaste Emporium!
The Team is excited to share these exciting new additions and fixes.

[b]Achievements[/b]
The following achievements have been fixed
[list]
[*] Fortuitous Fortnighter
[*] I Put A Spell On You
[*] Potion of Recognition
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
The following bugs have been resolved
[list]
[*] Double pick up item causing components to float and become untargetable
[*] Potion Cauldron floating causing potions to become untargetable
[*] Wrong items don't have enough force to be shot out of cauldron
[/list]

[b]Additional Detailing[/b]
The following have been added to add more intricacy to the game
[list]
[*] Added floor and shelf clutter
[*] Added new assets and detail work to store front
[*] Added clutter to main menu
[/list]

Thank you for your patience,
From the Posthaste Emporium Team

tags.bug: - Double pick up item causing components to float and become untargetable
- Potion Cauldron floating causing potions to become untargetable
- Wrong items don't have enough force to be shot out of cauldron

notes.title: POSTHASTE EMPORIUM: Update 1.2 Changelog & Major Fix
notes.content:
[b]Fixed fatal error preventing game launch if fixed.[/b]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue with players not being able to receive [b]Fortuitous Fortnighter[/b] Achievement.
[*] Fixed issue with players not being able to receive [b]Potion Of Recognition[/b] Achievement.
[*] Fixed issue with players not being able to receive [b]I Put A Spell On You[/b] Achievement.
[/list]

[b]Visual Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Added various clutter to environment
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Adjusted store layout in order to remove a dead end and improve overall flow.
[*] Lowered the force in which potions will be launched out of the cauldron.
[/list]
